preconditions.description: The number of ribbons is between 1 and 750.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= char <= 'b' for greeting in greetings for char in greeting)
preconditions.description: Each character in the greetings is either 'a' or 'b'.
The total length of all greetings does not exceed 10,000,000 characters.

postconditions.description: The size of the stylish set is between 1 and the number of ribbons.

postconditions.expression: all(greetings[i] not in greetings[j] for i in stylish_set for j in stylish_set if i != j)
postconditions.description: No greeting in the stylish set is a substring of another greeting in the same set.
The size of the stylish set is the maximum possible.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ribbon_number <= n for ribbon_number in ribbon_numbers)
postconditions.description: All ribbon numbers are within the valid range.
The ribbon numbers correspond to the ribbons in the stylish set.
